purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel geometry for Al Zawiyah, Libya; failed access and non-parcel layer outcomes are not treated as evidence that no cadastre exists.
name: Al Zawiyah

queries.query: Al Zawiyah Libya cadastral parcels land registry official map GIS
queries.result: Found the official Libyan Spatial Data Infrastructure portal, its RERA catalog records, and an official RERA Zawiya-area branch page. No city-bounded public parcel polygon service was verified.

queries.query: الزاوية ليبيا السجل العقاري مصلحة المساحة GIS خريطة قطع الأراضي
queries.result: Found the official RERA branch listing for the Zawiya area and the official LSDI portal catalog, which lists RERA parcel and parcel-database metadata. No public city-bounded parcel polygon response was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Libyan Spatial Data Infrastructure portal lists the Real Estate Registration Authority (RERA) and Survey Authority catalogs, including parcel-related metadata.
RERA first-party page lists the branch/administration for the Zawiya area, including South Zawiya and Zuwara administrations.
Published Arabic cadastral-law text describes RERA survey sections, parcel maps, and cadastral records; it is legal/procedural evidence, not an open parcel API.
Official LSDI GeoServer WFS endpoint exposed aoi_rera and aoi_upa layers in EPSG:4326; the exposed layer is an area-of-interest/general coverage layer, not a parcel feature service.

requests.outcome: HTTP 200; public HTML and JavaScript inspected. The viewer points to the LSDI GeoServer WFS endpoint and provides metadata routes. No login was attempted.
HTTP 200 JSON; RERA metadata records returned, including Cadastral Index Sheet, Final Property Drawing, and Parcel database.
HTTP 200 JSON; RERA Parcel database metadata says availability No, spatial representation Digital-Tabular, geographic location Libya, and no parcel geometry endpoint.
HTTP 200 XML; capabilities exposed LSDI:aoi_rera and LSDI:aoi_upa with EPSG:4326 and broad Libya bounding boxes.
HTTP 200 JSON; schema contains geom MultiPolygon, description, and md_fk. These are area-of-interest metadata fields, not a safe parcel identity schema.

HTTP 200 GeoJSON; response returned one very large regional/general AOI multipolygon spanning the area, not full parcel polygons. It was not retained as a sample and is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

registryBasis: A first-party RERA page evidences a Zawiya-area branch/administration, while the official LSDI catalog identifies RERA as the national real-estate registration custodian. This establishes a local custodian but not an open city parcel endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Libya-wide RERA/Survey metadata and LSDI geospatial service coverage, plus the RERA Zawiya-area branch listing.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous city-bounded parcel polygon response, safe native parcel ID, parcel field schema, or parcel CRS was verified. The only geometry response was a broad aoi_rera multipolygon in EPSG:4326.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity when independently verified
remainingUncertainty: RERA may hold paper maps or restricted/interactively served records for Al Zawiyah, and the LSDI catalog may not expose all data publicly. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used to force a parcel hit; the broad AOI response and unavailable/No metadata do not establish citywide absence.
